A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human">[[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family, as indicated by ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''noble''' was a member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The noble called for his Republic-allied House to side with the Empire, prompting other members of the family to exile him after fabricated evidence came to light painting him as a traitor.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Outright Sedition}}</ref>
